summary: Backend regression and targeted frontend integration checks completed for Live World simplification. Backend suite passed (37/37). Frontend critical flows mostly passed, with remaining verification gaps caused by intermittent Playwright selector timeouts despite visible elements.

integration_issues.flow: Automated world-page continuation checks after route changes
integration_issues.issue: Intermittent Playwright wait_for_selector timeout for [data-testid=world-page]/[data-testid=city-canvas] even when element is visible in call log; blocked completion of some remaining mobile+wallet assertions in same run.

action_items: Run one additional manual/agent retest for mobile overflow (390/375/320) and wallet modal/disconnect path due Playwright flake in this environment.
Optional: investigate repeated THREE.Clock deprecation warnings from runtime bundle to reduce console noise.
Optional: if animation proof is mandatory, validate with non-ReadPixels method (our strict pixel-motion probe was inconclusive once).
critical_code_review_comments: No backend auth/registry/showcase contract regressions found in this run.
New regression tests were made fixture-safe for parallel pytest runs to avoid false failures from temporary test tokens.
seed_data_creation: No permanent seed data created. Existing ephemeral pytest fixtures used and cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated: root and legacy showcase redirects, search Enter/Ctrl+K/clear/no-results, map controls, right-click non-navigation, token page tabs, owner-control hiding when disconnected, chart availability, join community route, Pump link mint binding, backend 404 for /api/showcase/* and live-world contracts. Remaining: re-run mobile overflow + wallet chooser/disconnect in one stable browser pass due intermittent selector wait timeout flake.
rca of the issue: Observed failures were test-harness/automation timing flakes: Playwright wait_for_selector timed out on selectors that were already resolved as visible in its own call logs. Reproduced across 3 scripts. This blocked completion of some later scripted assertions, not core app runtime health.
